final_answer.why_stop: S1: candidate_13 is feasible and currently lowest cost. S2: candidate_04 and candidate_05 were optimized and are more costly; every other candidate is screened by the declared lower-activity and higher-price rule relative to candidate_13. S3: highest-activity candidate_04 differs from candidate_13, but BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY were executed and the required activity gain is unreachable. S4: remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value; exact dominance/model-validity checks and MC are unaffordable.

unresolved_decision_risk.process_window_risk: A full admissible-domain grid was unaffordable. The incumbent was re-optimized in an expanded local edge window and improved; candidate_04/candidate_05 were optimized in the focused window. Residual risk is that a not-sampled process region could alter absolute costs, though the dominance screen and parity result make a change of industrial candidate unlikely.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_validity_risk: Formal CHECK_MODEL_VALIDITY was unaffordable (28 CU per check). Candidate_13 bed volume is well below the 90 m3 cap, but candidate_04/candidate_05 have very small beds and their edge/small-vessel validity was not formally checked; this would not favor them enough given current costs and unreachable activity parity.
unresolved_decision_risk.uncertainty_risk: Descriptor uncertainty was read but MC was unaffordable; candidate_13 has larger descriptor uncertainty than most candidates, so probabilistic cost ranking risk remains unquantified.
unresolved_decision_risk.overall: Low-to-moderate residual risk on exact absolute cost, low risk on industrial candidate identity under the computed evidence.
